title: Cobalt Blue Account: ATM Fees and Out-of-Network Usage
summary: Cobalt Blue Account details ATM fees for out-of-network usage: $2.00 per domestic U.S. withdrawal, and 2.5% of the withdrawal amount for international withdrawals with a $4.00 minimum. It also provides up to $15/month in out-of-network ATM fee rebates, plus possible additional ATM operator surcharges shown at the terminal.
faqs: What is the fee for a domestic out-of-network ATM withdrawal on my Cobalt Blue Account?
How are international ATM withdrawal fees calculated, and what is the minimum fee?
Are ATM operator surcharges included in the stated Cobalt Blue fees?
How much in out-of-network ATM fee rebates can I receive each month, and when do they stop?
Can I cancel a domestic out-of-network ATM transaction if the terminal shows an operator surcharge?
What are examples of domestic vs. international ATM fee amounts (e.g., withdrawing $100 or $200 abroad)?

International ATM withdrawal fee: 2.5% of withdrawal amount
